verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS code-review platform with a local CLI, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting, flag, or policy for disabling telemetry or usage tracking. Adjacent privacy claims exist: no training on customer code, 'Strict data retention', and self-hosted or air-gapped deployment. None of these says that product telemetry can be turned off, so they do not show this capability.
